test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is personal income?

options.text: The income earned by individuals and households after taxes and other deductions
The total income earned by businesses and corporations in an economy
The income earned by individuals through their own business or self-employment
The total income earned by individuals and households before taxes and other deductions

solution:
The correct answer is __**the total income earned by individuals and households before taxes and other deductions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Personal income** is the total income earned by individuals and households before taxes and other deductions.
 
• It includes wages, salaries, bonuses, social security benefits, dividends, interest, and rental income.
 
• Personal income is a measure of the **financial resources available to individuals and households for spending and saving**.
 
• It is an important economic indicator used to assess the economic well-being of the population and to predict future consumer spending.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disposable income** is the **income available to individuals and households after taxes and other deductions**.
 
• It represents the amount of money that can be spent or saved according to personal preferences.
 
• Personal income and disposable income are key metrics in macroeconomic analysis and policy-making.
 
• Understanding the levels and trends of personal income helps in assessing the overall economic health and planning for fiscal policies.
